sql: SELECT date_trunc('month',CAST(ordered_at AS timestamp without time zone)) AS order_month, SUM(total_usd) AS raw_source_amount FROM analytics.orders GROUP BY date_trunc('month',CAST(ordered_at AS timestamp without time zone)) ORDER BY order_month
